objective: Take up backlog B119 (G15) at the coordinator's go-ahead of 2026-11-10: can a learner that sees only its own dissonance and the address asked for (a bit per atom, each atom given by its region) write addresses into the layered memory exactly? status: Complete 2026-11-10: native writing, answered yes. A learner that sees only its own dissonance, the floor and the address asked for (a bit per atom, each atom given by its region) wrote 100 of 100 frozen addresses exactly on five spaces and each held, with no inexact stop; an acting atom's region always holds dissonance (P1, by hand), so the learner's probe can err only by a false 1, and a write changes only atoms found wrong (P2); without the probe 84 of 100 were inexact. Recommendation Research directions (B120, inputs and outputs).
